text.p: These are the leading stories in Botswana's independent midweek newspapers, The Sun and The Gazette, on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The government is to establish a 50 million pula fund to help citizen-owned contracting companies. Seven year loans at nine percent per annum interest will be offered and 30 percent of all government contracts are to be directed towards the companies to help them repay their loans.

- The Cabinet has been briefed by Commander of the Army, Lieutenant-general Seretse Khama Ian Khama, on growing dissent within the Botswana Defence Force over a refusal to pay certain subsistence allowances.
- The government is working on ways to scale down the civil service, says minister for presidential affairs and public administration, Ponatshego Kedikilwe.
- The Botswana Defence Force (BDF) will not take part in military exercises in Zimbabwe next month because of financial considerations, a spokesman said.
